content.short: Moonrank provides statistical rarity data for the Solana NFT ecosystem, with real-time rarity views and mathematical ranking.
content.description: Moonrank is a statistical rarity service for the Solana NFT ecosystem. It enables users to view the rarity of individual NFTs and discover new collections in real time, with rankings generated automatically and without any manual input. Developers can access the underlying statistics and insights. Every NFT collection on the platform is ranked using a mathematical methodology, providing a consistent and transparent basis for comparing rarity across listings.
